name: Colonial Hypergrowth
author: Oddisz
description: An Omega core can govern a colony, with three administrator skills of its own, and only an Omega core can take a colony past size 10, up to 15. Colonies past size 10 become Arcology Worlds, Ecumenopolises and finally Hyper-Ecumenopolises with an orbital ring, each with new looks and bonuses. Removing the Omega core from such a colony starts a Great Civil War. Compatible with AoTD's economy.
